learningObjectives: Generate initial XTestStepValues from linked Module defaults.
Populate an XTestStep from a clipboard message.
Recognize that missing clipboard fields retain existing values.
Apply independent naming and expected-value conventions.

elements.text: Name steps to distinguish operation, input and expected response; inspect actual Module references rather than depending on an unverified universal suffix rule. Names do not define execution ordering.

Independent example: create a disposable shop, retain its identifier, retrieve it and assert expected fields, then clean it up. A returned list is not automatically complete or ordered; follow the sandbox contract. Agree on maintainable names early, without treating one convention as a product prerequisite.

Auto fill Values accepts an initial XTestStepValue, an XTestStep or a whole API TestCase. It generates the selected scope using linked Module defaults. The former claim that a TestCase cannot be selected is incorrect for current documentation.

For clipboard filling, define attributes, copy an XML, JSON or text message, select an XTestStep and choose API Testing > Auto fill Values > From Clipboard. Matching values are filled; structure and other nodes remain intact. Values absent from the copied message retain their existing values.

Independent guidance: inspect populated defaults and retained values before execution. A suggestion or observed server value is not automatically the correct expected assertion; avoid inadvertently reusing stale data.

Defaults reduce repetitive typing, while expected outcomes still need independent definition. Clipboard filling is selective and is not a complete replacement of the message or all existing values. These notes are not a verified transcription of Academy slides.

Use a disposable step with several attributes. Fill defaults; then paste a message containing only some fields and inspect which values changed and which stayed. Academy exercise files were not accessed.

examPitfalls.title: Depending on names instead of references
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming a suffix proves which Module supplies a step.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Inspect references and define readable names.

examPitfalls.title: Rejecting TestCase selection
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming Auto fill Values only supports individual steps.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Current documentation also supports a whole API TestCase.

examPitfalls.title: Assuming clipboard filling clears missing fields
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Expecting absent values to be erased.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Inspect retained values; clipboard filling leaves absent fields as they were.

examPitfalls.title: Treating defaults as the oracle
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Assuming generated expected values prove correctness.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Confirm expectations against the service contract.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which approach reliably identifies the Module behind an API TestStep?

options.text: Depend on a universal Response suffix.
Inspect the TestStep reference and use descriptive names.
Assume a numerical prefix selects the Module.
Assume names always prove assertion correctness.

practiceQuiz.rationale: References establish the relationship; names communicate intent.

optionExplanations.A: A suffix is not a reliable universal identity rule.
optionExplanations.B: Inspecting the reference identifies the actual source.
optionExplanations.C: A name prefix does not select a Module.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which selection can generate defaults across an API TestCase using Auto fill Values?

options.text: Only one initial value; no broader scope.
The whole API TestCase, as well as a step or initial value for smaller scopes.

practiceQuiz.hint: Current documentation includes a TestCase scope.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Auto fill Values supports a TestCase selection.

optionExplanations.B: This includes all documented generation scopes.
optionExplanations.C: A screenshot is not a generation target.
optionExplanations.D: An execution log is not this target.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A copied JSON message contains some required attributes. How do you fill an existing API step?

options.text: Select the XTestStep and choose Auto fill Values > From Clipboard.
Replace the whole project with the JSON.

practiceQuiz.hint: Target the step, not the entire workspace.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The clipboard workflow supports JSON and preserves unmatched values.

optionExplanations.A: This ignores an available workflow and still needs inspection.
optionExplanations.B: This is the documented clipboard route.
optionExplanations.C: Clipboard filling does not replace the project.
optionExplanations.D: JSON is a supported clipboard message type.

practiceQuiz.scenario: As independent maintainability guidance, when should a team agree on readable test names?

options.text: Early, then revise deliberately as requirements evolve.
Never; a fixed product naming rule removes the need.

practiceQuiz.hint: Agree on intent before inconsistency grows.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Early agreement can reduce ambiguity without prohibiting later improvements.

optionExplanations.A: This supports consistent communication while permitting deliberate changes.
optionExplanations.B: An exam milestone does not determine project naming.
optionExplanations.C: Waiting for conflict delays useful agreement.
optionExplanations.D: No universal naming convention was established.

quickRecap.value: Initial value, XTestStep or API TestCase.
Select an XTestStep and use Auto fill Values > From Clipboard.
Absent clipboard fields keep existing values.
Inspect defaults against independently defined outcomes.
